lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Create a two-bar rhythm and describe a four-note melody contour that fits it.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Rhythm written with ta/ti-ti; contour named with step/leap awareness.

WATCH FOR
Writing pitches with no rhythm. Both layers need planning.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Compose and notate a four-bar piece with rhythm bed + melody. Perform it and note one edit you made.

Write a short reflection naming one artistic choice you changed and why. Movement or instrument work is optional, adult-supervised and can be described instead.
